claims.claim_vi: The source names six cases for idempotency: RESTful API requests, payment processing, order management systems, database operations, user account management, distributed systems and messaging.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit; only the names and order are used.

claims.claim_vi: GET, PUT and DELETE are idempotent by HTTP's design while POST is not; an idempotency key stored with the result makes retries safe; check-then-write without an atomic constraint can double-apply; at-least-once messaging requires the receiver to drop duplicates.
claims.verified_by: General knowledge of the author, not checked against an official document: the writing environment could only reach GitHub, and no official document for this topic is hosted there.

design_notes_vi: Hai khung ghi chú: ba chỗ client gửi lại, ba chỗ lặp lại bên trong hệ thống.
source_deviations: Source numbers six cases; the lesson keeps names and order, groups them into client retries and internal repetition, and adds a check-then-write example.
The HTTP method idempotency claim is the author's general knowledge and was not checked against the HTTP specification.
